headline: A reported SEC probe of Nvidia's accounting gave semis their worst week in 25 years (Semis ETF -17.8% on five days) and pushed the Nasdaq 100 into a bear market, so the AI sell-off has turned from multiples to trust in the numbers.
regime: Capitulation-grade risk-off: S&P -3.7% on the day and -8.6% on five (seven straight down days, fa4dcd770d7e), Nasdaq -10.0%, Semis ETF -10.6% on the day and -28.1% on the month, VIX 30. Nvidia fell 14% on a Reuters report of an SEC accounting probe (48ee83401e31) and neoclouds lost 22.3% on five days. The bottleneck trades held up best: cooling -9.9% and grid -11.3% on five days with POWL +3.9%, and the 10-year eased to 4.91%. Monday futures bounced hard (8aa8cc003363, 3cb5a6b96b53) and Morgan Stanley calls it a 'fat pitch' (777d6156866a), but nothing in the news yet resolves the accounting or financing questions.

theses.title: Power, grid and cooling, not chips, limit the AI build-out
evidence: GE Vernova's gas-turbine slots are 80% sold through 2032 (e2953244c682); Oracle's gigawatt Shackelford campus is fully permitted (bdc1583b7a49)
SpaceX's $74bn of AI campuses push power, water and grid into focus (cf2e6d5f46fc); grids straining under data-centre load (54ff3be9f60e)
Cooling -9.9% and grid -11.3% on five days versus compute -19.6%; POWL +3.9% and a Zacks Strong Buy (8fed47d43b6e)
Against: SoftBank's $3.7bn power-equipment charge (e2953244c682); Baird cuts VRT to Neutral, target $320 to $200 (f8d92690dda5); power_nuclear -16.2% on five days, SMR -27.9%
theses.change_note: Monday sketch from the digest alone produced this thesis independently (backlog plus relative strength). GEV backlog and Oracle permitting offset the SoftBank charge and VRT downgrade; held at 73.

theses.title: AI compute demand still outruns supply
evidence: SpaceX adds ~500MW of AI compute a month, aiming for 1GW a month by end-2027 (8a28560cd7d6); Nvidia estimates keep rising (5228c3f50523)
Server makers asking for higher prices, HPE +6% (be67e5342218); Lumentum CEO says physics favours fiber (47730e3951ad)
Against: part of demand is vendor- or off-balance-sheet-financed: SpaceX sold $32bn of AI chip debt off its balance sheet (242058b8d07e), Citi sizes Nvidia-financed DRAM demand at 12% (d0a6c7476a68)
theses.change_note: -5: demand data is still strong, but today shows how much of it rests on financing structures that are now under scrutiny. In the Monday sketch it held only in a softer form.

theses.title: Debt-funded neoclouds are where the AI cycle breaks first
evidence: Chanos: CoreWeave needs '$4 of capital for every $1 of revenue' (9b369e6dfe07); Nadella: 'selling to one or two customers is not a business' (1a707069f719)
New US curbs threaten neoclouds' Southeast Asia business (2231e1c04381); WULF CEO won't sign a lease in a 'terrible market' (f296876325f5)
Segment -22.3% on five days, IREN -34.9%; quality gate drops CRWV, NBIS, IREN, CORZ, CIFR, WULF, APLD
Against: Monday premarket rally in CRWV, IREN, NBIS (2231e1c04381); Anthropic IPO signals demand for CRWV (7aae06a9b455)
theses.change_note: +3: worst segment again, with new regulatory curbs and prominent customer-concentration and capital-intensity critiques.

theses.title: Memory is priced as if this is the peak of the cycle
evidence: Citi: even a full stop to Nvidia-linked financing cuts DRAM demand only ~12% (d0a6c7476a68); Micron rebounding (08a17ae8b7f8); MU revenue past $130bn (25a87f32bf51)
Against: Morningstar sees a NAND bust for SanDisk (93c4a4cfa19c); memory -36.4% on the month, worst segment; ETFs net sellers of STX (3a55a5cd6605)
theses.change_note: -5: the Monday sketch did not produce this thesis; it survives mainly because it was carried forward. The DRAM case holds, NAND keeps weakening.

theses.title: Hyperscaler capex is eating their free cash flow
evidence: Hyperscalers -11.4% on five days, ORCL -19.3% and still fails the quality gate; ETFs net sellers of META and GOOGL (adabe827e2be, a98e2ae83673)
Against: Alphabet at ~18-19x forward with $200bn+ in SpaceX and Anthropic stakes (29b15a4897e8); MSFT -7.3%, best in the segment
theses.change_note: No new capex or cash-flow data; ORCL weakness fits, Alphabet's valuation cuts against. Held.

theses.title: The AI trade is crowded and rates are high
evidence: Semis' worst week in 25 years (8aa8cc003363); Nasdaq 100 in a bear market (66ad81709100); seven-day S&P losing streak (fa4dcd770d7e)
Bitcoin hit a two-year low with record ETF outflows (9817826d5b98); Buffett 'pin lies in wait for every bubble' (080fef1588c1)
Against: Morgan Stanley sees capitulation and a 'fat pitch' (777d6156866a); steep slides rebounded 91% of the time (064109a1fe94); 10-year down to 4.91%
theses.change_note: -5: the thesis has largely played out (Semis -28% on the month) and positioning looks washed out; rates are now easing, not rising.

theses.title: The Huang probe puts Nvidia, and China export rules, at risk
evidence: Reuters: SEC probing Nvidia's accounting, stock -14% Friday (48ee83401e31); Singapore billings questioned (d4320f22ba53); NVDA -22.9% on five days
Huang's exit threatens the China turnaround (5bf44922048c)
Against: Trump administration pushes Huang's reinstatement, NVDA bounces (7eef5a787308, e65a5efb5454)
theses.change_note: +4: an SEC accounting probe is more serious than short-seller reports; the reinstatement push only partly offsets it.

theses.title: Vendor and off-balance-sheet financing is propping up AI demand
evidence: SpaceX sold $32bn of AI chip debt structured off its balance sheet (242058b8d07e)
Citi models a stop to Nvidia-linked financing (d0a6c7476a68); SEC probe touches Nvidia's billings (d4320f22ba53)
Anthropic prospectus carries a ~$1tn compute commitment (4d989ae16997); Chanos on CoreWeave capital intensity (9b369e6dfe07)
theses.change_note: New: four separate items today point at the financing loop behind chip demand, which the Monday sketch surfaced as the main new risk.

theses.title: A Democratic Congress raises policy risk for data-centre build-outs
evidence: Oracle's permitting win shows the backlash 'hasn't won yet' (bdc1583b7a49); bipartisan permitting and nuclear bills last week
Trade-rule risk (neocloud curbs, 2231e1c04381) is covered by the export and neocloud theses
theses.change_note: Retired: the Monday sketch found no evidence for it; it survived only by carry-forward, and permitting news argues against it.

compute.note: Cut from neutral: -19.6% on five days, NVDA -22.9% on an SEC accounting probe; AVGO held best.

foundry_equipment.note: -17.0% on five days; CAMT best; quality and cheap multiples intact (ONTO 13x).

memory_storage.note: -36.4% on the month; DRAM resilient per Citi, NAND bust risk per Morningstar.

networking_optical.note: -19.8% on five days, AAOI -34%; LITE and ALAB growth intact but momentum broken.

servers.note: -16.2% on five days; JBL held best and server makers are raising prices (be67e5342218).

power_nuclear.note: -16.2% on five days, but GEV slots sold through 2032; prefer cash-generative IPPs over SMR.

grid_electrical.note: Second-best segment (-11.3%), POWL +3.9%; demand is physical and backlogged.

cooling_thermal.note: Best segment (-9.9% on five days), though Baird cut VRT on valuation.

datacenter_neocloud.note: Worst segment (-22.3%), IREN -34.9%; capital intensity and new SE Asia curbs.

hyperscalers.note: -11.4% on five days, ORCL -19.3%; Alphabet at ~19x with valuable stakes.

ai_software.note: -27.8% on the month; CRWD buying ZS for $43.9bn (95c0ffee526b) is the only bid.

risks: The SEC probe finds misstated Nvidia revenue, forcing estimate cuts across the whole supply chain.
Vendor and off-balance-sheet financing dries up, cancelling orders at neoclouds first and suppliers next.
Monday's bounce fails and the Nasdaq 100 bear market deepens through a thin holiday week.
Ackman's recession warning (9650227cae8b) comes true and hits even backlogged power and grid names.
Anthropic breaks its IPO price and shuts the AI financing window.
watch: Whether Monday's premarket rebound holds into the close, and VIX versus 30.
Any SEC or Nvidia statement on the accounting probe, and the Huang reinstatement decision.
HPE results (6da1be89e14e) and Dell Q4 (4f2abf991a5c) for server pricing and AI backlog.
Grid and cooling relative strength versus compute if the rebound broadens.
